# Agent packages

<!-- Generated by tools/clientrecipes from src/agentpackages.json; edit the source. -->

Read the [common setup and credential rules](README.md) first. [All recipes](index.md).

Client: **Agent Package Manager 0.35.0**. Registered classes: **local, federated**.

Endpoint: `${AW_URL}/artifactory/api/agentpackages/${AW_REPO}`

## Before connecting

- HTTPS origin trusted by the client. APM_EXTRA_CA_BUNDLE may name a private CA bundle.
- Run publish in a producer directory with apm.yml and included assets; install in a separate consumer project with its own apm.yml.

Authentication: APM sends AW_TOKEN as a Bearer token via APM_REGISTRY_TOKEN_AW. READ resolves packages; DEPLOY publishes. Use a token issued for the intended principal and repository grants; do not use the upstream service credential.

Fresh client state: AW_APM_HOME is a newly created directory. Prefix every apm command with env HOME="$AW_APM_HOME" to isolate configuration and caches.

## Configure

The client registry alias is aw; it does not have to equal the repository key.

```sh
umask 077
AW_APM_HOME=$(mktemp -d)
export APM_REGISTRY_TOKEN_AW="$AW_TOKEN"
env HOME="$AW_APM_HOME" apm experimental enable registries
env HOME="$AW_APM_HOME" apm config set registry.aw.url "$AW_URL/artifactory/api/agentpackages/$AW_REPO"
env HOME="$AW_APM_HOME" apm config set registry.aw.default true
```

producer/apm.yml; add the content to package, such as .apm/skills/help/SKILL.md. Use a distinct name/version in consumer/apm.yml.

```yaml
name: my-pkg
version: 1.0.0
includes: auto
dependencies:
  apm: []
  mcp: []
scripts: {}
```

## Publish

Classes: **local, federated**. Publish from the producer directory.

```sh
env HOME="$AW_APM_HOME" apm publish --package acme/my-pkg --registry aw
```

## Install or resolve

Classes: **local, federated**. Run from the separate consumer directory. Exact and ranged resolution are tested.

```sh
env HOME="$AW_APM_HOME" apm install acme/my-pkg#1.0.0 --target claude
```

## Limits

Classes outside **local, federated** are not registered for this format. Commands above apply only to each operation's listed classes. Federated evidence is for one node; it does not establish cross-vendor replication.

- Registry support is explicitly enabled as an experimental feature in this pinned APM release.
- Remote and virtual classes are unsupported; federated proof is one node.
- The JFrog CLI is used for other agent formats; this format has actual native APM publish/install proof.
